title: Shinseina Ki — Sacred Heartwood
revision: Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Wood classification / forked tree

classification.selector: jutsu classification: the qualifying element(s), whatever the jutsu's source
classification.applies_to: matching supported tags on all Wood jutsu
not_selectors: equipment / required bloodline item (castability gate only)
classification.off_kit_coverage: unverified (no non-bloodline jutsu catalog with effect rows in the repository)

emphasis.primary: Self amplification — Forest Wisdom's two Increase Damage Given rows, both live after one 40 AP cast and compounding (+6% route)
emphasis.secondary: Exposure — Guardian's Grove's area Increase Damage Taken, which multiplies every attacker's hits on the caught enemies (one row, +10% route)
emphasis.tertiary: none: Wood Damage (40 / 40 / 50 EP) is deliberately unamplified, because any flat Damage lifts Eternal Forest past the 50 Nuke tier
emphasis.rationale: Shinseina Ki is a rank-A Burst kit whose six supported rows are three Wood formula hits (Exploding Wood Serpent 40, Guardian's Grove 40, Eternal Forest 50 EP at jutsu level 25; 60 AP, cooldown 7), two 35% self Increase Damage Given rows on the 40 AP Forest Wisdom cast, and one 35% Increase Damage Taken row on Grove's circle. Its burst already comes from those three multipliers compounding (×1.35³ ≈ ×2.46 on a window hit), so the tree amplifies the multipliers, not the hits: Hallowed Seed answers "How do I make my own strikes land harder?" (self amplification on every own hit, any target) and Grasping Roots answers "How do I make the grove mark them for everyone?" (exposure that also multiplies allies' hits). Flat Damage is left out because Eternal Forest is a 50 EP Nuke. Recoil, poison, wound, summon and visual rows are unsupported, and Wood Warrior Summon (PVP only) carries no supported row. Potency reaches matching supported tags on all Wood jutsu (RUL-2026-10-03-005).

nodes.name: Hallowed Seed
nodes.flavor: From one blessed seed the whole forest follows, and every branch remembers it.
nodes.coverage_note: Forest Wisdom Increase Damage Given rows 0 and 1 35 → 37% (self; both live for the 2 rounds after one 40 AP cast).

nodes.name: Rooted in Wisdom
nodes.flavor: Age is not years but rings; the sage reads them and strikes where the grain runs.
nodes.coverage_note: Forest Wisdom rows 0 and 1 37 → 38% with Hallowed Seed; the commitment step, kept small because every point lands on two compounding rows.

nodes.name: Heartwood Awakened
nodes.flavor: The sacred tree opens its eyes, and its will moves through every limb at once.
nodes.coverage_note: Self amplification: both Forest Wisdom rows 35 → 41% on the full route (+6%), compounding to ×1.41 × 1.41 ≈ ×1.99 (×1.82 at base) on own Wood and element-less hits for 2 rounds.

nodes.name: Grasping Roots
nodes.flavor: Roots find the ankle first. After that, everything else finds the mark.
nodes.coverage_note: Guardian's Grove exposure 35 → 37% (enemies in the circle, 2 rounds; range 4, 60 AP, cooldown 7).

nodes.name: Rootbound Prey
nodes.flavor: Held fast in living timber, the prey can only watch the canopy lean in.
nodes.coverage_note: Grove exposure 37 → 40% with Grasping Roots; no element and all four stat types, so hits from the caster and allies alike count.

nodes.name: Judgement of the Grove
nodes.flavor: The grove has deliberated long enough. Its sentence arrives from every side.
nodes.coverage_note: Exposure: Grove 35 → 45% Increase Damage Taken on the full route (+10%), so the caught enemies take ×1.45 instead of ×1.35 from every attacker for 2 rounds.

examples.name: Heartwood Awakened
examples.rationale: Both Forest Wisdom rows 35 → 41% for the two rounds after the 40 AP cast: ×1.41 × 1.41 ≈ ×1.99 instead of ×1.82 (about ×1.09) on every own Wood and element-less hit (kit attacks, basic attacks, weapons) against any target; other Earth or Water hits get both rows with the caster's highest stat, else row 1's ×1.41. Grasping Roots is the only legal fourth purchase (Grove exposure 37%); with Forest Wisdom and Grove cast together in a duel, the window hit is ×1.41² × 1.37 ≈ ×2.72 against ×2.46 unmodified (about ×1.11).

examples.name: Judgement of the Grove
examples.rationale: Guardian's Grove's area exposure 35 → 45% for the two rounds after the cast: every hit the caught enemies take, the caster's Serpent, Eternal Forest and basic attacks and every ally's hit, is ×1.45 instead of ×1.35 (about ×1.07); Grove's own hit lands in its cast round and is not amplified. Hallowed Seed is the only legal fourth purchase (Forest Wisdom 37% on both rows): in a duel the window hit is ×1.37² × 1.45 ≈ ×2.72, level with Heartwood Awakened, while allies hitting the circle gain ×1.07 instead of ×1.01.

examples.name: Seed and Snare
examples.rationale: Both Hidden Arts and no capstone: Forest Wisdom 38% on both rows and Grove exposure 40%. In a duel the window hit is ×1.38² × 1.40 ≈ ×2.67 (about ×1.08), below either capstone (about ×1.11), in exchange for some of each: ×1.04 on own hits away from the circle and ×1.04 on allies' hits inside it.

narrow_kit_exception: Six nodes and two Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has three supported tags on six rows (Damage x3, Increase Damage Given x2 on one cast, Increase Damage Taken x1), and this revision targets two of them. Flat Damage is declined: Eternal Forest is a 50 EP Nuke, so any flat Damage lifts it past 50, and the previous +5 route (Fangs of Heartwood → The Forest Devours) took Serpent and Grove 40 → 45 and Eternal Forest 50 → 55; that branch is removed rather than re-cut. The two identities are two 3-node chains: Hallowed Seed → Rooted in Wisdom → Heartwood Awakened (self amplification) and Grasping Roots → Rootbound Prey → Judgement of the Grove (exposure). Universal nodes accepted: with two 3-node chains every 4 BP build holds both Foundations, so the choice is which chain to finish, or the no-capstone hybrid (both Hidden Arts). A second Hidden Art under either Foundation could only repeat Increase Damage Given or Increase Damage Taken on the same rows (filler, and it would stack with that root's capstone).
design_notes: Structure: edges 01→04→05 and 06→07→08. Hallowed Seed +2% / Rooted in Wisdom +1% / Heartwood Awakened +3% Increase Damage Given (route +6%); Grasping Roots +2% / Rootbound Prey +3% / Judgement of the Grove +5% Increase Damage Taken (route +10%). Three legal 4 BP builds: each capstone plus the other Foundation, and the no-capstone hybrid. Maxima over every legal allocation: Increase Damage Given +6%, Increase Damage Taken +10%, no Damage.

Why the printed totals differ: every Increase Damage Given point lands on both Forest Wisdom rows, which compound, so the +6% route is ×(1.41/1.35)² ≈ ×1.09 on own hits while the +10% exposure route is ×1.45/1.35 ≈ ×1.07 on every attacker's hits. In a duel, with Forest Wisdom and Grove cast in the same round, both complete builds reach about ×1.11 over the unmodified ×1.35³ window; self amplification also covers targets outside the circle, exposure also lifts allies.

Damage is not targeted. Before this revision the Burst route reached +5 (Serpent and Grove 40 → 45, a full tier; Eternal Forest 50 → 55), and Judgement of the Grove's +1 and Fangs of Heartwood's +2 alone lifted Eternal Forest to 51 / 52. Any flat Damage does the same, so the kit's burst is left to its three native multipliers.

Interactions (SOURCE_MECHANICS §3/§3b): Forest Wisdom row 0 (no element, Highest filter) matches the kit's Wood hits, every element-less hit of any stat and elemental hits of the caster's highest stat; row 1 (Earth/None/Water/Wood) matches those elements. Matching rows each multiply the hit, and Grove's exposure multiplies again; the bloodline passive (25+0.15/level, Wood/Earth/Water/None) multiplies last.

Delivery and timing: cooldown 7 on every jutsu; buff and debuff rows act only in the two rounds after their cast. Forest Wisdom (40 AP, SELF) and Grove (60 AP, radius-1 circle on an OTHER_USER target, range 4) fit one round, so Serpent and Eternal Forest land in the shared window; Grove's exposure never amplifies its own hit.
risks: Classification: Wood is the single qualifying element; sharing it with Nature's Blessing is expected (RUL-2026-10-03-005). Forest Wisdom row 0 and Grove's exposure carry no element, so they need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver. Wood Warrior Summon carries no Wood row and no supported row. Off-kit Wood coverage (NORMAL/SPECIAL/EVENT/FORBIDDEN) is unverified.

Stacking: Heartwood Awakened's two Forest Wisdom rows compound with each other and with Grove's exposure (×1.41² × 1.37 ≈ ×2.72 on a window hit in its complete build); Judgement of the Grove's 45% applies to every enemy in the circle and to every attacker's hits, so its team value grows with the number of allies. Not simulated.
Ally hazard: Grove's damage and poison rows (friendly fire absent = ALL / ALL) still reach allies in the circle, but no node raises them; the exposure row is ENEMIES only.
Skill-tree effects are skipped in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING. No combat simulation was performed.

audit.revision: Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Wood classification / forked tree
limits: Proposed element-wide potency classification; not implemented or verified in the live engine (needs a jutsu-classification resolver).

Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Wood jutsu. Off-kit jutsu of the element are in scope by rule; their count is unverified. Original combat elements, recipients and stat/general/element filters stay intact.
Bloodline id, equipment, injected-child provenance and jutsu names are not selectors; equipment only gates castability.
Coverage counts below are this kit's rows only. Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.
Damage values are raw power (EP), not final-damage percentages; every other modifier is shown with %. Percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.

Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.
Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.
No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.
Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit.

foundation_sentences.01: How do I make my own strikes land harder?
foundation_sentences.06: How do I make the grove mark them for everyone?

route_identities.05: self amplification: every own hit, any target, in the Forest Wisdom window
route_identities.08: exposure: the Grove circle multiplies every attacker's hits (team, area)

design_review.director_review: Structural: the Damage route (Fangs of Heartwood → The Forest Devours) is removed rather than re-cut, because any flat Damage lifts Eternal Forest past 50; the tree shrinks to two chains with both Foundations universal. Confirm, or choose the Blood-Enchanted Eyes pattern as a third route (exposure setup → +2 Damage payoff, Serpent and Grove 40 → 42, Eternal Forest 50 → 52).
concerns: Heartwood Awakened is held at +6% because both Forest Wisdom rows compound; Rooted in Wisdom at +2% (route +7%, about ×1.12 in a duel) would make self amplification the default even in duels.
Rooted in Wisdom's +1% is a small printed step; it keeps the no-capstone hybrid (about ×1.08 in a duel) clearly below both capstones (about ×1.11).
Exposure's advantage is team play; in solo fights against several enemies self amplification is stronger because it does not depend on the circle.
